name: Elixir Capital Limited
about: Elixir Capital Limited, together with its subsidiaries, trades and invests in shares and securities in India. The company offers stock and commodity broking, portfolio management, arbitrage and proprietary trading, and demat services. It also provides capital market research and analysis services; and advisory services, as well as depository services. The company was formerly known as Axis Capital Markets (India) Limited and changed its name to Elixir Capital Limited in September 2015. Elixir Capital Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.
